d:
This song serves as an anthem that reflects the chaos and calm within me, much like the city of Mumbai. I explore how I navigate this journey, using my skills to articulate these experiences. In the verses, I employ metaphors and punchlines to convey the duality of my emotions and the complexities of life in this vibrant city.
